summary: NFT Ltd, a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting three registered direct offerings priced October 6, 8 and 9, 2026, closing October 7, 9 and 13, 2026. The October 6 tranche comprised 150,000 common units at $1.35 and 1,740,000 pre-funded units at $1.31, raising roughly $2.55 million gross and $2.12 million net; the October 8 and October 9 tranches each issued 600,000 common units at $1.00 and 400,000 pre-funded units at $0.96, raising about $1.0 million gross each. Each unit bundles a Class A ordinary share or a $0.04-exercise pre-funded warrant plus a five-year common warrant initially exercisable at the applicable offering price, subject to a 4.99%/9.99% beneficial ownership cap and share-combination adjustments. Proceeds fund NFT platform and AI robotics expansion, working capital, general corporate purposes and D&O insurance. This is an ordinary shelf-style capital raise, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, premium or overhang terms beyond warrant dilution.
